what: The Verhaak et al. (2010) ClaNC 840-gene signature resolved to the GENCODE v36 symbols of gene_annotation.parquet. No patient data.
rule: direct if the published symbol is in the annotation; else the unique HGNC approved symbol (HGNChelper 0.8.16 hgnc.table) that is in the annotation; else excluded (ambiguous or not_in_annotation)
